==Errors==
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=1m16s|text=1:16}} [[Bashere]] did ''not'' bring [[Taim]] to [[Rand]]. Taim came by himself. This is probably a misinterpretation of [[Saldaean]] guards escorting Taim from the palace entrance to Rand and Bashere.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=1m50s|text=1:50}} Taim was not testing for the [[spark]]. He was testing for the ability to channel. In fact, we know that [[Damer Flinn]] in particular did ''not'' have the spark, because men with the spark start channeling in their teens or twenties, and Damer was a balding old man at the time of the testing.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=2m15s|text=2:15}} The wording here implies that the [[Salidar]] embassy arrived on the same day as [[Taim]], but they arrived days or weeks later.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=2m53s|text=2:53}} [[Berelain]] spent ''months'' away from Rand after he gained ''[[Callandor]]''. She only rejoined him after the liberation of [[Cairhien]]. Saying she had not left his side is probably some AI way of noting that she was loyal to Rand.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=3m19s|text=3:19}} It's "a" [[Gray Man]], not "the" Gray Man. Moreover, why does the illustration show a Gray Man dressed conspicuously and wielding fireballs? Gray Men look and dress very plainly and their only magic is being almost unnoticeable.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=4m22s|text=4:22}} [[Galina]] was the ''current'' leader of the [[Red Ajah]] at the time of Rand's capture, not the "former" [[Highest]]. More importantly, there were '''''thirteen''''' Aes Sedai including Galina, ''not'' three. The use of young-looking [[Aes Sedai]] to hide their numbers is why this worked.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=5m22s|text=5:22}}, {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=5m33s|text=5:33}} [[Perrin|Perrin's]] force did ''not'' go east to chase Rand's abductors. They went north (and a bit west, crossing the [[Alguenya]] river), since this is the direction that the [[Aes Sedai]] went, and the direction of the [[White Tower]], ''and'' the direction of the [[Shaido]]. East wouldn't make any sense.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=5m52s|text=5:52}} The ''[[Siswai'aman]]'' are not a discrete "community" of [[Aiel]]. And they do ''not'' consider themselves "subordinate only to the [[Dragon Reborn]]." They also follow [[Clan chief|clan]]/[[sept chief|sept chiefs]] and [[battle leader|battle leaders]], etc, though they are ultimately loyal to Rand personally as the ''[[Car'a'carn]]''.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=6m16s|text=6:16}} The wording implies [[Perrin]] first recognized the [[Two Rivers]] men by their banners when he saw them, but he already knew who they were through his communication with the wolves.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=14m13s|text=14:13}} The animation implies that [[Masema]] traveled to [[Ghealdan]] from [[Andor]]/[[Cairhien]] (seemingly around the time of [[Dumai's Wells]]). But he'd been in the vicinity of Ghealdan since {{3}}, shortly after the events at [[Falme]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=17m03s|text=17:03}} The Saldeans and the [[Legion of the Dragon]] did not "fail" to capture [[Sammael]]. That was never their purpose or intention; [[Rand]] always intended to deal with Sammael directly.

==Nitpicks==
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=2m17s|text=2:17}}, {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=7m09s|text=7:09}}, {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=10m53s|text=10:53}} "Sorceresses" is not a term that gets used in-universe. [[Aes Sedai]] are called "Aes Sedai," "channelers," or "witches."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=3m00s|text=3:00}} [[Aes Sedai]] are ''definitely'' never called "wizards." Not even [[Asha'man]] are ever called "wizards."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=3m19s|text=3:19}} [[Rand]] appears to be holding a dagger backwards, which has no apparent basis in the books at all.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=3m22s|text=3:22}} It's "[[balefire]]," not "a balefire." One wouldn't say someone used "a balefire" any more than one would say someone drowned in "a water."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=3m33s|text=3:33}} The on-screen note refers to [[Kiruna]] and [[Bera]] coming "from the embassy in the [[Aiel Waste]]." Kiruna and Bera ''were'' the embassy sent to the Aiel Waste (so they couldn't come "from" it) and they likely never actually reached the Waste before redirecting to [[Caemlyn]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=3m58s|text=3:58}} The narration says [[Rand]] berated [[Berelain]] for neglecting ''his'' duties. That might be technically correct if "his" refers to Rand, but the awkward phrasing implies Berelain is male. She is very, very female.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=4m06s|text=4:06}} "Ministries" is a very odd word to refer to the [[Aes Sedai]] embassies, and certainly is never used in-universe.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=4m30s|text=4:30}} The odd wording implies that the trunk used to capture [[Rand]] was carried out of the [[Sun Palace]] ''before'' Rand was put in it, which is obviously silly.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=4m54s|text=4:54}} It's the "[[Feast of Lights]]," not the "Festival of Lights."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=6m20s|text=6:20}}, {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=7m44s|text=7:44}}, {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=7m56s|text=7:56}} Yet again, it's "the [[Two Rivers]]," NOT "Two Rivers."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=6m43s|text=6:43}} Yes, [[Sevanna]] was the wife of [[Suladric]], but that seems an odd way to describe her given that her marriage to [[Couladin]] was more recent, more identifiable, and was mentioned in the [[User blog:Androlf/W&W 7: Siege of Cairhien|video about the battle of Cairhien]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=8m20s|text=8:20}} The on-screen note says that [[Aes Sedai]] pass an "exam" to become Aes Sedai. That's not ''technically'' incorrect, but "testing" is less misleading and is the word used in-universe.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=13m07s|text=13:07}} [[Rand]] did not "move" to [[Rhuidean]]. He briefly [[Traveling|Traveled]] there.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=13m23s|text=13:23}} It's "the [[Choedan Kal]]," not "Choedan Kal."
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=14m01s|text=14:01}} The wording is weird. The "friends" in question were [[Rand]] and [[Perrin]].
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=15m30s|text=15:30}} [[Fain]] was a peddler, not a merchant.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=16m15s|text=16:15}} The wording is weird. While [[Mat]] was present in the [[Caemlyn]] attack, it was [[Rand|Rand's]] attack and Mat's presence was largely incidental. Also, while Mat was involved in planning the [[Illian]] attack, it was hardly just his plan.
# {{Link|url=https://youtu.be/rDWpmzKjQ5w?t=17m19s|text=17:19}} It's "[[Mashadar]]," not "the Mashadar."
